reviews.text: Very good place and helpful

We’ve had such a lovely experience with VV Marylebone. Everyone is always so kind & gentle with our Toto and every time she comes in they make such a fuss over her which I love

Toto recently had X rays, ultrasound and dental treatment under general anaesthetic and Emma was amazing throughout. I was nervous about the anaesthetic but she made me feel much better and kept me updated throughout the day.

So grateful to everyone there for always taking such good care of our little madame ❤️

What a lovely vet clinic! My dogs are my kids and I’m so happy to have found them a warm, relaxed, clean & knowledgable clinic thank you!

Update from 2026:
I came to virtue vets and saw Dr Haley again with my new rescue dog Eden, she developed seperation and increased general anxiety too since moving here and I’ve grown so worried for her. I signed up her up for the membership today and the subsequent appointment brought me so much hope. Thank you!!!
Friendly staff 🥰 …

Lovely, caring veterinary practice. We went to both the Chelsea branch and Marylebone with our two dogs. Both times the dogs were treated in a caring and compassionate way and we felt in very capable hands. Their fee structure is reasonable too, with after care included in the price of the surgery. This is worth knowing in a time where veterinary care has risen by far more than inflation.

Great doctors especially Millie who looks after my babies. I have signed up for their membership.
The clinic is really hygienic which was one of my main concerns with super friendly staff.
I would totally recommend.

Took my cat Bella here after a frustrating experience with another vet. Dr Haley found a bladder stone with a routine ultrasound on the first visit - something that had been missed elsewhere across multiple appointments and nearly £530 in tests. Clear communication, no unnecessary upselling, and already started Bella on a treatment plan. Really wish I'd come here first.

Virtue Vets is excellent! I can’t recommend them enough. They are not located in my part of London but it’s worth the journey. I have a cat with rare health issues and I’ve seen several vets here over the last year, including the Feline Advanced Practitioner- Patricia, and we’ve seen Gia, Emma and Alison. They are all great. There is always continuity of care- even when we are in an emergency situation. Someone has always been available to speak when we’ve had emergencies with both of our cats - either the Receptionist, the Nurses, and of course the Vets if they’re available- and if not they schedule a call in with them. I also Love that they are open on weekends- it's incredibly helpful. As someone who’s been to a lot of vets, clinics, specialists and hospitals for my cats I cannot say more positive things about this place. I’d also say their prices are reasonable.

My cat never had a grooming before because I was always scared to take him anywhere knowing Meryem how good she is with the pets so I decided to take it and I’m so glad I did especially this time of the year when the fur are just constantly coming out it made a huge difference Thank you so much, honey. See you in eight weeks time.

⛔️Absolutely terrible experience with this company 😭.Many general checkup appointments with great feedback on puppy's health and no concerns.When we decided to choose an insurance (just in case)-realised that something which was never mentioned to us as a "concern" (puppy was 9 months) turned up to be......"preexisting condition"already for the insurance based on their notes!!! Now NO insurance will ever cover in the future if this becomes necessary due to this! It was so shocking as you would never expect this to be done after “all was fine”  whithout informing you as a owner how it works!To ruin clinical history of 10 months old puppy with no isurance cover for the future that is the last thing anyone would expect when you trust. And to resolve it - nothing was even offered by management (apart from the most expencive quote in Central London) and kind suggestion that there are plenty of other clinics with better prices if we wish😁So any future expences now we will have to cover with NO insurance due to this “transparent”approach and care. Never would reccomend to anyone💔⛔️. They only care of the money!If customers are valued and something  done wrong by you
- you would  not show them where the door is...Terrible experience 👎🏻👎🏻👎🏻

My dog had a terrible injury and needed immediate attention. I took him to a couple vets in the area but it felt like they were more interested in making money than actually helping my dog. A neighbor recommended Virtue Vets and I’m forever grateful. My dog was seen immediately by the lovely Allison, and I was given clear information about what needed to happen and how much it would cost. My dog is healthy again and I will always recommend Virtue Vets to every pet owner I know. Nothing but love for this place ❤️

Enzo and Richie was seen by Allison, the lead veterinarian and she was amazing! This clinic is so nice and spacious and offers you coffee and treats for the e dogs as soon as you enter. I can’t stress enough how supportive and helpful they were.
Allison is an excellent vet who always gives sound advice and exceptional service. She has treated my dogs for years and I recommend her highly.

The people who work at Virtue Vets Marylebone are what makes this vet office so special. Dr. Allison has an easy, comforting personality. She’s practical, yet thorough and gentle. Vet Tech Noko is like having a second doctor on hand. My cat, Lola, loves her. And receptionist Alex always makes us feel welcomed. I know I can walk into Virtue Vets at any time, even without an appointment, just to say hi or ask a question. It’s a true neighborhood establishment. I’m really glad I found Virtue Vets and I’d highly recommend them.

Best vets in London! The atmosphere is so calm and relaxing. I have a very shy cat and they make sure she always has a pleasant time, she loves all the treats they gave her ;)
Love Virtue Vets <3
Friendly staff and good care for my pet. Positive experience overall
Great clinic and the staff is very helpful 😊 …

We have been visiting them since we got our puppy over 6 months ago. they have always been great and the monthly plan they have is also very good and has great coverage. They have been very nice and professional.
I had an excellent stay here! The vets were absolutely exceptional, we even had a French vet, which is a considerable advantage.

Alyson at Virtue Vets has been nothing short of exceptional in navigating what has been a genuinely complex case with my dog. This was one of those tricky presentations where the answers weren't obvious — the kind that requires a vet who truly listens, thinks carefully, and builds a clear, considered plan rather than rushing to conclusions.
That is exactly what Alyson has done, and continues to do. She has been patient, thorough, and unhurried at every appointment, making us feel heard and reassured each time we've seen her. In a situation that could have felt overwhelming, her calm and methodical approach has made all the difference.
A true gem — we are so grateful to have her in our corner. Thank you Alyson!
Super friendly and competent staff - thank you
The vets here are 10/10, incredible range of expertise and knowledge. Would recommend!
Great clinic. Fair prices, amazing staff. Thank you so much
The only place I would trust with my cat! Everyone that works here is so kind. I have have had wonderful experiences with Noko, Alex and Allison!

I cannot recommend the Marylebone Virtue Vet practice highly enough.

From day one, the experience has been nothing short of exceptional. The team is consistently warm, welcoming, and genuinely caring—not just toward the animals, but toward owners as well. It’s clear that everyone who works there is deeply passionate about what they do, and that really shows in the level of attention and kindness they bring to every visit.

Winston loves going to the practice to say hello, and he is always greeted with love and plenty of treats. It’s such a reassuring feeling to see him so relaxed and comfortable in what could otherwise be a stressful environment. You can tell they’ve created a space where animals feel safe and cared for.

If you’re looking for a vet who combines professionalism with genuine compassion, this is absolutely the place. I’m incredibly grateful to have found them and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for top-quality care for their pets.
Love the whole virtue vets team! They’ve always been incredibly kind and understanding with my dog. Always helpful with both advance and urgent bookings

We absolutely love the team at Virtue Vets Marylebone! They have taken such good care of our pup Ellie. Everyone is really friendly and helpful and appointments can be made easily with not much of a wait. All the nurses and vets we’ve seen have been great and answered any and all questions, but Dr. Haley has been phenomenal when Ellie needed to have multiple surgeries. I always feel Ellie is in great hands and have felt informed every step of the way. Would recommend Virtue Vets if you’re in the Marylebone area!

It feels like family at Virtue Vets in Marylebone, whenever I take my cats for their appointments everyone is so warm and caring and give such outstanding care and treatment. They are always so accommodating. I always leave feeling reassured and happy. Thank you VV!

Such a great experience at Virtue Vets. My dogs even like going to the vet now!  Danielle, the physio is wonderful and now has a relationship with my beautiful Grace so we’re going to make Grace’s life better and more comfortable.

We used Allison at Virtue Vets for a call out for our sick Labrador. Allison was fantastic. She was incredibly responsive when we contacted Virtue Vets, listened to our dog’s symptoms and made herself available for a call out the same evening. Allison came to our home with the medication needed, she took the time to explain everything to us providing us with  the confidence our dog was in experienced, caring hands and she was lovely to our dog who was clearly very fond of her. Thank you Allison for your kindness.
Really lovely caring staff - best vets in Marylebone.
The best vetinary practice, so friendly and caring. Also the best vet in practice with Allison Harvey. Highly recommend.
Knowledgeable and kind staff. Nice, calming atmosphere. Thank you for taking care of my cats!

As always great experience even our cat Roo likes going there now, Allison is just the best and really knows how to make animals relax. Other team members are also fab and I would highly recommend Virtue Vets to anyone who wishes the best care for their pets and prices are very reasonable.

We moved recently to London from New York with our cat Chester and were looking for a caring & knowledgeable vet practice. We have definitely found a gem in Virtue Vets in Marylebone. Dr. Allison has a great “bedside manner” and makes Chester feel at ease. It makes going to the vet with a cat just a little less stressful.

called through for some urgency out of my own anxious and Ana picked up the call to discuss and analyse everything very detailedly for me and my cat, patient and considerate. we did not end up needing to visit them right away but she and her professionality has definitely helped me alot in this situation, definitely a super nice person. Just wanted to leave a good review for that for thanking the heartwarmingly supportive attitude.

I don’t even know where to start—Allison has been amazing. I’m in the process of moving to South Africa, and she’s made everything so much easie!

She’s incredibly responsive, knowledgeable, and always takes the time to explain things clearly. I would highly recommend her.

Just visited Alison who was our vet previously at Village Vets in Hampstead. I’m delighted I managed to find her again and registered now at Virtue Vests as Alison is one of the best vets who really cares and couldn’t recommend her highly enough. Virtue Vets Marylebone 5 stars 🌟 …

Luxury vet care at its finest. My dog actually enjoys coming here because of the treats and the friendly greeting he gets at the door. It’s clean, modern, and smells nothing like a typical vet office!

I wish I could give them less than that.I have spoke with them regarding travelling with my pet and what are the procedures.They have staff working for them who don’t have any experience and don’t know accurate information.I have been misinformed and now I’m in a situation where I have to leave my pet all alone.😭😭😭 …
Always very caring and will do the most for your fur babies

Thank you for seeing my dog in an emergency when i was nowhere near home, and thank you for being so reassuring and explaining everything to me!

P.S. she made a full recovery!!

I can’t recommend Virtue Vets highly enough, and a huge part of that is thanks to Gia. After contacting more than 25 vets who either couldn’t or wouldn’t help with exporting my pet turtles from the UK to Europe, I was completely discouraged. From the very first moment, Gia was the exact opposite — supportive, knowledgeable, and genuinely dedicated to helping me.

She guided me through every single step of the export process for my two turtles, Oogway and Victor, and kept me constantly updated at all stages. Communication was always clear, fast, and reassuring, which made a very stressful process feel manageable and organised.

What stood out most was her consistency and care — I never once felt forgotten or left in the dark. Gia went above and beyond, and without her, this move simply would not have been possible. If you are looking for a team that truly cares and delivers on what they promise, Virtue Vets — and especially Gia — are exceptional. 🥰🐢

I can’t thanks enough Ally, Noko  and Alix for their kindness and professionalism with our little Gina.
I highly recommend them 🥰 …

I had a wonderful experience at Virtue Vets Marylebone with Allison! My kitty Blues was getting his AHC certification, which was a lengthy 10 pages that Allison kindly pre-filled to ensure the most efficient possible with time. In terms of service, cost and just the MOST wonderful staff, I will always choose to trust Virtue Vets with my pets. Plus they’re so thoughtful with treats, the name of each room ‘Pawtofino, Barkcelona, Meowkonos, and little stickers that say “I was brave at the Vets”, honestly to cute! Thanks so much again! From Blues & Grace x

The best experience ever our 7 years old Bolonka  had in a vet clinic - he was  neither scared nor nerveous ! Spending a long weekend in London our dog developed a serious health issue. On short notice we got an appointement - and Dr. Allison Haley diagnosed immediately the malefunction of his digestive system. She run a blood test and gave us a detailed and online
evalutation over the weekend.
We are most gerateful for the exemplay service of the entire Virtue Vets0 Maryleborne team.

REALLY impressed with this vets. Needed a second opinion on an incorrect diagnosis from our previous vet. Alison is a wonderful!  Kind and amazing with our dog Teddy.
He’s well on the mend now.
Prices are sensible and it’s an extremely high end experience. Both the animal and human experience have been really considered.
All staff we’ve interacted with have been beyond helpful. The large selection of in house treatment options is a huge plus (including physio which does not require a vet referral)

I absolutely love this place! As a first-time dog owner, I couldn’t have asked for a better experience. The staff are incredibly kind, caring, and always on hand to answer any questions. I’ve even messaged them out of hours and received responses that truly wowed me—showing how dedicated they are. Their support and reassurance have made my journey as a new dog owner so much easier. I can’t recommend them highly enough.
Dear Will - you've left a one-star rating with no explanation. We request you contact us and let us know where we might have fallen short and we will do our best to fix it.
No one seem to care

Our family cat had a tragic accident and passed away. After calling many vets (on the weekends) I came across Virtue vets. Honestly, I cannot begin to express my sincere gratitude to the team who helped me. Ruby was so considerate, so friendly and understanding. She managed to register us over the phone to save us time and was extremely thorough, thoughtful and patient with us when we took our Marshmallow to clinic. The duty vet was amazing.. super friendly and extremely considerate of our situation. They both went above and beyond their time (since the clinic was past closing time) just to answer all of our questions and take in our cat, and even gave us a lovely sympathy card with pawprints and fur to remember Marshmallow. I will forever be grateful and I highly recommend Virtue vets especially the lovely Ruby and the amazing duty vet (I wish I asked for her name, she has an american accent if i'm not mistaken).  Please send our appreciation to her! Thank you once again for a wonderful service at such a sad time and for being so understanding. All the best x
Thank you so much for the 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your support. 🐾 …
Really great service. Very friendly and good clinical skills. Easy to access and good subscription plans that are competitive with insurance plans. Would highly recommend.
Thank you so much for the 5 stars! We really appreciate your support and hope to see you and your pet again soon! 💛🐾 …
Fantastc came in to for a tic removal The place is brand spanking new. The people were lovely. My vet. Teague was very informed and helpful and patient highly recommend.

I had a great experience from the booking process till the end of the visit.
Amazing and professional staff that makes you and your pet feel like at home!
Transparent pricing (and very affordable!), the team is focussed on providing the best treatment and advices for your pet and not on checking some boxes.
I am definitely a new customer now and I do highly recommend this clinic!
Dear Giulia - you've left a one-star rating with no explanation. We request you contact us and let us know where we might have fallen short and we will do our best to fix it.

My dog (a large Bernedoodle) and I have had an absolutely phenomenal experience at Virtue Vets. After being referred to the practice by a friend in the neighbourhood, I was blown away by the level of service and care that we received from the minute that we walked in the door. I was treated just as well as my dog was! This is not just a beautiful facility, but also, an office full of amazing and knowledgeable staff members who actually took the time to answer all of my questions. It completely reassured me about his level of care here in the UK and will make our travels so much easier each time we go back abroad. My dog adores this place so much that he will sometimes insist on "pulling" me over there when we are on our way to the park just to say hello to the staff members (and maybe get some extra treats as well!). Thank you very much!

High tech, totally professional, scrupulously clean and instantly welcoming, Virtue Vets are absolutely the best veterinary practice I have ever had the pleasure to deal with.

We first met Jenny at a previous clinic and it was our great fortune to reconnect with her at VV. Our young cocker spaniel Lola Rose suffered from juvenile nephropathy and very sadly we lost her last month. Words cannot describe how exceptional Jenny and her team were. We will be forever grateful for the many kindnesses they showed to our precious Lola and us. Professional, compassionate, knowledgeable and empathetic, a safe pair of hands, thank you from the bottom of our hearts, where you will always have a special place.
Thank you for the review!

I recently had the pleasure of taking my dog, Oliver, to Virtue Vets, and I couldn't be more impressed with the level of care and attention they provide. From the moment we walked in, the staff was so welcoming, and the facility is clean, modern, and well-equipped, which immediately put me at ease.

Kiekie, the vet that that took care of Oliver, was so knowledgeable, compassionate, and patient with him, as he can be quite high energy! She answered all of my questions and I really appreciated her taking time to explain the medication I needed to administer when we got home.

Overall, my experience was fantastic, and I highly recommend Virtue Vets to anyone looking for a trustworthy, caring, and professional veterinary team. They go above and beyond to ensure pets receive the best care possible! Thanks Virtue Vets!
Professional, knowledgeable and caring everything you want to take of your fur baby
All the staff. Very friendly and professional.

We’ve had a phenomenal experience with Virtue Vets. The whole team are lovely, professional and super knowledgeable. The facilities are high tech and beautiful, and each of our experiences have been very positive (so much so that my dog pulls me in the door!). We’ve used Virtue for standard care (e.g. rabies vaccination), travel paperwork (including UK export papers and support with import requirements), and a full cardiac scan. They’ve been amazing every time.
Popped in to register & query a limp in my  dog.  Ginny gave a thorough examination and an immediate remedy to alleviate the situation. Great team - lovely clinic
Thank you for the review!
Really great vets, lovely people, neat place
Thank you for the review!
